en: Sepia-toned historic street scene showing a bustling urban street lined with multi‑story buildings and shops. In the background stands a prominent Baroque-style church or tower with an onion-shaped dome and clock. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. Red printed captions at the top read a city name on the left and a street name on the right. The reverse side has a green 5‑fillér Hungarian stamp, printed red text along the left margin, and handwritten Hungarian correspondence and address lines.
